title: n-type Mg2Si, Mg2Ge, Mg2Sn: archived calculations of the conduction states at X (Sugawara 2026, Zenodo 23319151)
codes: ecalj (all-electron LDA, one-shot G0W0, QSGW; PMT basis), Questaal 7.14.1 (QSGW and QSGW with ladder diagrams in W, Mg2Si), BerkeleyGW 4.0 + Quantum ESPRESSO 7.3.1 (pseudopotential PBE and G0W0; PBE momentum matrix elements), Quantum ESPRESSO 7.3.1/7.5 (electron-phonon, LDA). No spin-orbit coupling.
structure: antifluorite (Fm-3m); X = (1, 0, 0) in units of 2 pi / a (three equivalent X valleys); W = (1, 1/2, 0).

lattice_constants_A.note: room-temperature values, used by the production calculations

bands.returns: ecalj band energies along L-Gamma-X-W-Gamma (bands N_v-2 ... N_v+4), production calculations; QSGW at the final self-energy.

x_scan.returns: ecalj fine scan from X, 21 points with step 0.004 (2 pi / a), bands N_v ... N_v+3.

qsgw_box.returns: QSGW (final self-energy) energies of bands N_v+1 and N_v+2 on a box of wave vectors on one side of X: q = k - X with 0 <= q_par <= q_max, 0 <= q_y, q_z <= q_max (one octant of the neighbourhood of the valley along x), on a uniform grid. coarse: step 0.02, q_par <= 0.24, q_y, q_z <= 0.16 (all three compounds); fine_0.01: step 0.01, 0.20 / 0.14; fine_0.005: step 0.005, 0.10 / 0.07 (Mg2Si only).

momentum_matrix.returns: Mg2Si only, pseudopotential PBE (Quantum ESPRESSO): energies of bands 13 and 14 (the two lowest conduction states at X; bands 1-12 occupied) and |<13|p|14>|^2 summed over the three Cartesian components (atomic units), at up to 40 points (q_par, q_y, q_z) of the coarse-box grid per request.

tote.returns: Rows of an ecalj TOTE file at Gamma and X (bands N_v-1 ... N_v+3), as written by the code, with its first line.

questaal.returns: Questaal eigenvalues (Ry) of bands 1-12 at Gamma and X for Mg2Si (band 4 is the valence-band maximum).

pseudopotential_g0w0.returns: BerkeleyGW eqp1.dat rows at Gamma and X: band, E_DFT (PBE) and E_qp (eV).

electron_phonon.returns: Electron-phonon renormalization of the band edges (meV), LDA with pseudopotentials: AHC per state (all broadenings), ZG as changes of X3 - X1 and of the gap.

tote_note_from_archive_README: Columns: q (three, units of 2 pi / a), band, q index, the eigenvalue of the Hamiltonian that entered the calculation, the quasiparticle energy eQP (Z = 1), eQP without Z, and Z; energies in eV. The one-shot G0W0 values of the paper are eQP; in a QSGW run the file of iteration N holds, in the first energy column, the eigenvalues of the static QSGW Hamiltonian built from the self-energy of iteration N - 1.
